output.diagnosis: spec_error: DWELL(inspection, 1500ms) has max_speed=null so any time inside the zone counts. Counterexample has 0ms still but 1.835s transit >1.5s, so dwell is satisfied and rule PASSes while truth is FAIL. Rule text 'stay at least 1.5 seconds' means stopped/stationary time, not pass-through time.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample: still-time 0ms <1500ms so DWELL false, BEFORE false, rule FAILs as labelled. In general slow drive_throughs with transit>1.5s flip PASS->FAIL; canonical >=1.5s stopped stays PASS; brief_stop stays FAIL.
proposals.rationale: 'stay' requires being nearly still. Adding max_speed ~stopped requires 1.5s continuous nearly-stationary time in inspection before crossing, not just transit time.

proposals.expected_effect: Same as above but more tolerant to center jitter during a true stop; drive-through at belt speed still rejected while stationary dwell still counted.
proposals.rationale: Looser stopped threshold to capture intent while tolerating tracking jitter; still requires stillness, rejecting moving transit.
